card.name: Linking words in cough and breathing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or word parts (such as 'such', 'with', 'than', 'aged', 'the') in respiratory label text about cough, colds, sleep apnea or airway problems, often just before an age, a number or a condition.

modes.label: Before age limits
modes.description: A space, 'aged' or 'than' right before an age in cough and cold or flu dosing text.
modes.example: are not recommended for children under age<< >>4. · Antibiotics should not be

modes.label: Before a respiratory condition
modes.description: A linking word such as 'such' or 'with' that leads into a cough or airway cause.
modes.example: for possible underlying pathology,<< such>> as foreign body or lower respiratory tract disease

modes.label: Inside airway terms
modes.description: A word or part of a word within airway or sleep-breathing wording.
modes.example: urgent intervention indicated (e.g., tr<<ache>>otomy or intubation) Perman

card.writes: It lowers breathing-related words such as breath, breathe and breathing as the next word; the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in cough, cold and airway text, where the next word is not about breathing.
